Like I said — Your partner is inside the Haven hall. Go through the door to meet them.
Why can’t I do this now?
Still the same thing — Your partner is inside the Haven hall. Go through the door to meet them.
"Please, go on."
"Okay. We'll pick this up later."
They fill the quiet. "Anyway — where was I?"
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
"What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about? That's the whole of it."
"I'm better with my hands than people expect. You'll see."
"Noted. Filing that under 'extremely useful.' The village needs that."
"I'm listening, I promise."
"I can do trapping. Not well — well enough that nobody's died from it yet. That's my whole résumé now: nobody's died from it yet."
"Wait — what were we talking about?"
"Still on what you're good at. You'll see."
"I'm listening, I promise."
"Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone?"
"Every day. I go for walks that don't need to happen. Just to breathe my own air."
"Here's the thing: I get it. Solitude's a resource too. Scarcer than food, some days."
"I'm listening, I promise."
"I go to the treeline edge and count my breaths. Ten of them. That's my alone. Then I come back — alone is a luxury, and also a little bit a lie."
"I'm listening, I promise."
"Anyway — I should get going."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"I don't know what to do with my hands today."
"Hey — you alright?"
They shake their head, then nod — both true at once. "Talk to me a bit. That helps more than anything."
"You said something odd the other day. Let's talk about it."
"We went over this," James says, a little tired. "I already told you the truth about that."
"Are you okay?"
A long exhale. "I'll get there. Just needed a minute where I didn't have to be fine."
"How are you holding up? About... them."
"Since Karim died... I keep expecting to see Karim at the fire. Stupid."
"Want to come with us?"
"...Fine. This had better be worth it."
"What happened next?"
"I should go. You know where to find me."
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
I'm not dying for anyone's principles. I do what keeps me breathing. Remember that.
"I’m listening."
"The will to live isn't poetic. It's stubborn. I'm stubborn."
"Tell me more."
"One more day. That's the goal. It's always been the goal. Everything else is decoration."
"Go on."
"Whatever it costs. I've decided. Some people haven't decided yet — that's what'll kill them."
"I’m listening."
"Survival isn't pretty. It's Tuesday. It's boring and relentless and I choose it."
"Tell me more."
"I've made peace with doing what I have to. The peace is uneasy, but it's peace."
"I'm here. Go on."
"Alright — I should get back to it."
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
"This was good." They mean it.
